name: v40 settings sensitivity + leave-one-region-out (W3, W3b); frozen before any run
frozen_at_commit: see git log: chore: freeze v40 settings-sensitivity + LORO protocol (pre-results)
separate_from: protocol.json (stress-test protocol; its md5 is unchanged by this file)
metric: pearson_r (overall per-region proportion Pearson r vs SingleR GT; complementary rmse/mae/jsd are recorded)

baseline.description: The published Xenium QP call (baseline.run_xenium_qp): CitegeistModel(simulation=True) -> filter_gex(min_counts=25) -> preprocess_gex(target_sum=10000) -> preprocess_antibody -> load_cell_profile_dict(profile) -> run_cell_proportion_model(lambda_laplacian=0.0, nuclei_counts=<label-derived>)
baseline.gate_reference: results/gate (A11 gate run, unperturbed baseline); per-region baseline r from this sweep must equal it within 1e-4 BEFORE any delta is read

markers.note: major_plus_minor: Minor markers are promoted into Major for that run, because the QP ignores Minor.

nuclei_source.note: label_derived = per-spot count of non-Unknown cells (published). all_segmented = per-spot count of ALL mapped cells incl. Unknown (must equal oracle_counts_*.csv). stardist_dapi = precomputed StarDist-DAPI nuclei counts. none = nuclei_counts=None.

expected_conditions.derivation: (4-1)+(4-1)+(3-1)+(2-1)+(2-1)+(2-1)+(4-1) = 14 non-baseline levels (the baseline level of each setting is the single baseline condition). Task brief text says '15 non-baseline'; the spec level lists give 14 non-baseline + 1 baseline = 15 conditions. No level was invented to reach 15.

stardist_dapi.sanity_check: all_segmented per-spot counts must equal oracle_counts_region_<r>.csv exactly (verified 5/5 regions at freeze)

robustness_rule.statement: A setting level is robust iff |mean over regions of (r_level - r_baseline)| <= 0.02 AND no single region has |r_level - r_baseline| > 0.05
robustness_rule.reporting: Every prespecified level is reported with mean delta r, worst-region delta r, and robust yes/no. Known breakers (gating off, Major+Minor) are reported as such. A failed grid cell is reported with its failure status and is never dropped.

loro_rule.statement: For each held-out region h and each setting (one-at-a-time, the other settings held at baseline): choose the level maximizing mean r over the OTHER four regions; report r on h for the chosen level next to the baseline r on h. Ties (equal to 1e-12) go to the baseline level. The baseline level of each setting is included as a candidate.
loro_rule.caveat: One-at-a-time LORO understates tuning bias from JOINT tuning of several settings; it measures only single-setting selection.
loro_rule.summary: Per held-out region: held-out r of selected vs baseline, delta; mean of deltas across held-out regions.

not_covered.gex_detection_k, gex_detection_min_corr: not in the prespecified level list
not_covered.fusion_mode union vs intersection (chang: only on/off of GEX detection is tested
not_covered.filter_gex min_counts=25, preprocess_gex: not in the prespecified level list
not_covered.antibody winsorization 5/95 (before-eval: not in the prespecified level list
not_covered.profile dictionary composition beyond Mi: the stress test ablation/type-removal axes address marker availability, not dictionary edits
not_covered.SACE settings: single E-step, cells_per_: this protocol is QP-proportion only; SACE is not rerun
not_covered.5-region Pearson r selection of the abov: see loro_rule: LORO covers only the covered settings
